purpose: Record that the stored audit reproduces on a platform different from the recorded one.
install: pip install snappy regina numpy sympy; then pip install --ignore-installed packaging passagemath-standard
install_note: passagemath-standard fails with "Cannot uninstall packaging 24.0, RECORD file not found" on a Debian-based image because packaging came from apt. --ignore-installed packaging fixes it. While passagemath is only partially installed, snappy itself fails to import: sage_helper takes the Sage branch and then cannot find sage.algebras. Finish the install before using snappy.
